title: Binding
description: The base definition for any token binding. Binds a token to a specific resource and participant so it cannot be reused against a different resource or by a different participant. Capabilities define specific binding types.

type.description: The binding type discriminator. Set to the capability name that owns the bound resource, for example `dev.ucp.shopping.checkout`. Specific schemas will constrain this to a constant value.

identity.description: The participant this token is bound to. Required when acting on behalf of another participant (e.g., agent tokenizing for merchant). Omit when the authenticated caller is the binding target.
